text: Where does all the carbon we release go? Carbon moves through a natural cycle, present in all living things: in the soil, in the oceans, in the atmosphere and in rocks deep underground. Natural events like volcanic eruptions release some of the carbon trapped in rock. And human activities, like burning fossil fuels, also release some of that prehistoric carbon.
